investment_theses.thesis: BTC outperforms SPY over next 6 months as macro tailwinds (sticky inflation, Fed patience, EM conflict premium) offset AI correction risk.
supporting_signals: BTC jumped to $81.5K on Q3 GDP beat (3.4%); PCE inflation at 3.7% YoY signals Fed won't rush cuts.
Kalshi $40B valuation + Polymarket ultra-short products indicate institutional crypto adoption accelerating.
Eisman warns AI trade at tipping point but broader macro (geopolitics, EM flows) still supports risk assets; BTC as macro hedge outperforms tech.
investment_theses.counter_view: Eisman's AI correction warning could trigger sharp deleveraging across crypto and equities alike; BTC not immune to VC/tech fund redemptions if mega-cap AI stocks (NVDA, GOOG) crater.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC (spot or perpetual swap), short SPY (or hedge with SPY puts). Ratio trade: BTC/SPY momentum ratio.

investment_theses.thesis: Semiconductor & AI infrastructure supply chain consolidates; NVDA underperforms as open-source LLM competition (Mistral, Llama) erodes training capex economics.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Alphabet earnings miss tied to search cannibalization; AI capex ROI in question.
Hacker News top story: Mistral Large 4 weights released (754 upvotes); open-source models reducing demand for $40K+ H100 clusters.
Eisman pivot to de-risk AI positions suggests smart money exiting before broader correction.
investment_theses.counter_view: NVDA remains sole supplier of performant training silicon; open-source inference doesn't cannibalize training demand; enterprise AI adoption will accelerate capex through 2027.
investment_theses.expression: Short NVDA or MU (memory demand softens), long semiconductor cost-reduction plays (e.g., Taiwan Semiconductor—TSM) or defensive mega-cap tech (MSFT).

investment_theses.thesis: Prediction market platforms (Kalshi, Polymarket) capture disproportionate share of 2026 financial innovation TAM; institutional flows drive valuation re-rating despite regulatory headwinds.
supporting_signals: Kalshi $40B valuation on $1B+ non-sports run rate (Cointelegraph) implies 40x revenue multiple; IPO or secondary likely in 2026–2027.
Polymarket ultra-short crypto markets launch (CoinDesk); US regulation (Kalshi raising $1B) signals institutional confidence.
NYSE owner ICE backing Hyperliquid perps (Cointelegraph); traditional finance infrastructure integrating crypto derivatives.
investment_theses.counter_view: Regulatory crackdown on prediction markets (CFTC/SEC) could curtail growth; Kalshi valuation already reflects bull case and lacks diversified revenue streams beyond sports/politics.
investment_theses.expression: If Kalshi IPO files: overweight pre-IPO shares or secondary market access. Alternatively, long Hyperliquid (HYPE) token as derivative play on permissionless prediction market demand.

investment_theses.thesis: Tokenized real-world assets (RWA) transition from hype to adoption in 2026; Canton Nov 2026 launch signals institutional readiness; Ethereum/Polygon infrastructure wins.
supporting_signals: Cointelegraph: Canton Strategic Holdings (Nasdaq-listed) tokenized stock trading Nov 2 2026 launch.
CoinDesk: Chainlink weekend pricing for tokenized assets with Aave partnership; infrastructure maturation.
Polygon-Solana stablecoin partnership (CoinDesk) hints at multi-chain RWA rails emerging; Ethereum maintains lead.
investment_theses.counter_view: RWA adoption hamstrung by regulatory fragmentation (Swiss spot Bitcoin ETF exception, not norm); custody/settlement complexity limits institutional uptake in 2026.
investment_theses.expression: Long Ethereum (ETH spot or staking rewards), long Aave (AAVE governance token on RWA narrative), or accumulate Chainlink (LINK) as infrastructure play.
